newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed, fuel oil firm, mogas soft.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed, fuel oil firm, mogas soft.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Thursday, with gasoline easier with crude but fuel oil firm on good demand, traders said.
Gasoline remained easy with and stocks still looking generally long despite lower production levels as refiners miximise on more profitable distillate production.
Naphtha talked at slightly lower levels as volatile and nervous crude trade kept buyers relaxed waiting for fresh direction to be establied.
An industry fuction in Paris was also responsible for taking many players away from their desks.
Gas oil was steady with a weaker tone. The market was quiet but more for want of cargoes than lack of demand, traders said.
Two Russian cargoes were on the water but it was unclear whether they had been sold already. Premiums were assessed at quotes cif high +$2.0/+$2.50, basis Genoa.
"Premiums are steady even though there appears to be fewer Russian cargoes available this month,"one trader said.
A number of French refiners were reported to be looking for FOD, but no deals were heard.
Fuel oil was firm and demand good.
A trader seeking to cover his Portuguese commitments was heard holding two Isab term cargoes and another two cargoes obtained on the spot market.
Bunker product was tight. "Good quality stuff is about as common as rocking horse manure," one dealer said.
Low sulphur barrels were well offered into Italy. Most discussion was quotes-related, however.

Two M-40 cargoes were offered at around m/m/m +$5 but one refiner said the quality was poor. He expected two M-100 cargoes to be offered shortly. A French refiner was heard having paid cif high +$2-$3 for an M-100 on Wednesday.
